parameters.name: credentialID
parameters.description: ID of the DNS credential, as the list shows it

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Relations to add to the answer: any of `owner` (the user who created it), `certificates` (the certificates that use it) and `domains` (the names of its DNS domains), separated by commas.

200.description: The DNS credential, without its values

description:
Returns one DNS credential. The answer shows which fields are set (and the value of a field that is not secret), never a secret value or a raw credentials file.

Needs: Certificates view
